estimates.assumptions: Using the supplied measurement of 250g directly as the edible portion for the fillet steak (raw weight before cooking).
Medium carrot is typically ~61 g each when peeled and trimmed; 2 carrots = 122 g total edible portion.
A typical Chinese/napa cabbage head weighs ~900-1000 g; half is therefore ~450-500 g edible trimmed weight; used 454 g (1 lb equivalent).
One medium spring onion (finely sliced) weighs ~15 g after trimming; 4 onions = 60 g total edible portion.
A small handful of fresh coriander leaves is realistically 10-20 g; used 15 g as a modest average edible amount.
One medium red chilli (sliced, seeds in) weighs ~15 g after trimming stem.
Juice of one average lime yields ~30 g (≈ 2 tbsp) of edible juice.
1 tsp rice vinegar weighs ~5 g; caloriesPer100g left null as no known value supplied and it is a very low-calorie seasoning.
One average garlic clove (chopped) weighs ~3 g after peeling.
